name: Convert surface datatypes to cortexmap datatype
summary: Converts surface/vertices and surface/data datatypes into a cortexmap, renaming GIFTI files into Connectome Workbench conventions for use with its viewers; a format conversion utility.
description: Copies the left and right GIFTI surfaces into cortexmap surf/ (adding lh./rh. prefixes and .surf.gii), and the left/right surface data into func/ as data.func.gii, or into label/ as parc.label.gii when a label.json is present. Use it to view or further process surface data with the cortexmap Apps; no resampling or computation is done.

inputs.description: Left and right hemisphere surface data (GIFTI) and an optional label.json; treated as a parcellation when label.json exists, otherwise as metric data.
Left and right hemisphere surface meshes (GIFTI) that the data are defined on.

outputs.description: cortexmap with the surfaces in surf/ and the data in func/ (metric) or label/ (parcellation).

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.cause: No data file was copied into the cortexmap.
failure_modes.fix: Check that both surface data hemispheres were provided.
